name: Aichlech mac Dubdrenn
text: Aichlech mac Dubdrenn slew Fionn mac Cumhaill. The killing took place at Áth Brea, a ford on the Boyne. Aided Finn records this version. A more famous account sets Fionn's death in Cath Gabhra, struck down by five warriors.

attributes.attribute: the killer of Fionn mac Cumhaill at Áth Brea on the Boyne River
named in the tale Aided Finn
